metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming and funny live-action/animation hybrid about a polite bear who finds a home in London, similar to the family-friendly adventures and humor of films like 'Paddington 2' and 'Tangled'.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Continues the heartwarming and hilarious adventures of Paddington Bear, with a strong emphasis on kindness and family, echoing the positive themes found in 'Encanto' and 'My Neighbor Totoro'.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A wild and visually inventive animated comedy about a quirky family on a road trip who must save the world from a robot apocalypse. It shares the humor and family dynamic of 'Inside Out 2' and 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie'.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An visually stunning animated adventure with incredible action and heart, following Miles Morales as he reunites with Gwen Stacy and is catapulted across the Multiverse. It has the same energy as 'Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse'.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical animated musical adventure from Walt Disney Animation Studios, celebrating the power of wishes. It fits with the adventurous and magical tone of 'Moana' and 'Tangled'.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning animated film exploring themes of belonging and connection in a city where fire, water, land, and air residents live together. It has the heartwarming family themes of 'Coco' and 'Turning Red'.

metas.name: Migration
metas.description: An animated comedy about a family of ducks who embark on a hilarious vacation, encountering unexpected challenges. It's a fun adventure with plenty of laughs, similar to 'Rio' and 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie'.

metas.name: The Boy and the Heron
metas.description: A critically acclaimed animated fantasy adventure from Studio Ghibli about a young boy who enters a magical world. It appeals to fans of 'Howl's Moving Castle' and 'Spirited Away'.

metas.name: IF
metas.description: A live-action and animated fantasy comedy about a young girl who can see everyone's imaginary friends, leading to a whimsical adventure. It shares the imaginative spirit of 'Monsters, Inc.' and 'My Neighbor Totoro'.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: An animated adventure where a young boy overcomes his fears with the help of the literal embodiment of Night. It has the imaginative and friendly vibe of 'Monsters, Inc.' and 'Ponyo'.

metas.name: The Tiger's Apprentice
metas.description: An animated action-adventure where a boy discovers he is destined to become the guardian of a magical phoenix. It has the action and fantasy elements of 'Raya and the Last Dragon' and 'The Sea Beast'.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: Po, the Dragon Warrior, must find his successor and embrace a new role. It continues the action-packed comedic adventures of the beloved characters, fitting with the 'Kung Fu Panda' series.

metas.name: Mufasa: The Lion King
metas.description: A prequel exploring the origin story of Mufasa, told through flashbacks by his son, Simba. It offers a new perspective on the beloved characters from 'The Lion King II: Simba's Pride'.

metas.name: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
metas.description: Continues the action-packed adventures of Sonic and his friends, based on the popular video game franchise. It matches the high-energy action of 'Sonic the Hedgehog 2'.

metas.name: That Christmas
metas.description: An animated holiday comedy about a family's chaotic but ultimately heartwarming Christmas. It aligns with the family-friendly holiday spirit of 'The Grinch'.

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: Vengeance Most Fowl
metas.description: The beloved inventor and his canine companion return for a new mystery and adventure. Fans of 'Chicken Run' will enjoy the stop-motion charm and witty humor.

metas.name: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
metas.description: A gentle animated drama about a young girl's experiences and imagination. It fits with the heartwarming and character-driven stories like 'My Neighbor Totoro' and 'Ponyo'.

metas.name: KPop Demon Hunters
metas.description: A vibrant animated musical comedy adventure about a group of K-Pop fans who battle demons. It shares the genre-bending fun of 'The Super Mario Bros. Movie' and 'Sing 2'.

metas.name: Swapped
metas.description: An animated adventure comedy about a young boy and his dog who swap bodies, leading to hilarious situations. It has the body-swap humor and adventure of films like 'The Parent Trap' (in spirit) and 'Turning Red'.

metas.name: GOAT
metas.description: An animated comedy about a mischievous goat who causes chaos. This sounds like a fun, lighthearted adventure in the vein of 'Ice Age' and 'Rango'.

metas.name: Hoppers
metas.description: An animated adventure film focusing on a group of characters facing challenges. This promises exciting journeys similar to 'Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget' and 'Tangled'.

metas.name: The Bad Guys: Haunted Heist
metas.description: A sequel to the animated action-comedy where a group of reformed bad guys pull off a heist. It maintains the fun heist elements and humor of 'The Bad Guys'.

metas.name: The Electric State
metas.description: An animated science fiction adventure about a teenage girl navigating a surreal post-apocalyptic world. This will appeal to fans of the visually rich and adventurous style of 'Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse'.

metas.name: Spellbound
metas.description: An animated musical fantasy about a princess who must break a spell. It combines the musicality of 'Encanto' and 'Moana' with the fantasy adventure of 'Tangled'.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
metas.description: An animated epic fantasy adventure set in Middle-earth, exploring the story of Helm Hammerhand. For fans of grand adventure and fantasy like 'Castle in the Sky'.

metas.name: Shrek 5
metas.description: The return of the beloved ogre and his friends for more fairy-tale satire and hilarious adventures. This will be a treat for fans of 'Shrek 2' and 'Shrek'.

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: The sequel to the popular animated adventure comedy, following Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde. It continues the witty social commentary and exciting investigations of the original 'Zootopia'.

metas.name: Inside Out 2
metas.description: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear, and Disgust have been running a smooth operation until Riley turns into a teenager. New emotions arrive, adding to the emotional rollercoaster. It continues the insightful and fun exploration of emotions from the first film.

metas.name: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
metas.description: Ginger and her flock must break into a supposedly safe haven for chickens. This stop-motion adventure offers the same blend of humor, suspense, and heart as the original 'Chicken Run'.

metas.name: Puss in Boots: The Last Wish
metas.description: Puss in Boots discovers that he has burned through eight of his nine lives. He sets off on an epic quest to find the mythical Last Wish. It's a visually stunning and action-packed fairy tale, fitting with 'Puss in Boots'.

metas.name: The Sea Beast
metas.description: A legendary monster hunter and a young girl form an unlikely bond while sailing into uncharted waters. This animated adventure boasts thrilling action and beautiful animation, similar to 'Raya and the Last Dragon'.

metas.name: Turning Red
metas.description: A 13-year-old girl turns into a giant red panda whenever she gets too excited. This coming-of-age story is filled with humor and heart, resonating with the themes of family and self-discovery in 'Encanto'.

metas.name: Rango
metas.description: A chameleon's accidental adventure leads him to the town of Dirt, where he becomes a sheriff. This quirky and visually distinct animated western comedy is a unique gem, similar to the humor in 'Ice Age'.

metas.name: Howl's Moving Castle
metas.description: A young milliner is cursed by a witch and seeks refuge in a magical moving castle. This enchanting animated fantasy adventure from Studio Ghibli is captivating for its imaginative world and characters, much like 'Spirited Away'.

metas.name: Ratatouille
metas.description: A rat named Remy dreams of becoming a chef in Paris. This delightful animated comedy is about following your dreams and features charming characters and a wonderful setting, akin to 'Monsters, Inc.'.

metas.name: Encanto
metas.description: The Madrigals, a family blessed with magical gifts, are the only ones who live in an enchanted house in the mountains. Mirabel, with no gift of her own, is the only hope to save her magical home. It's a vibrant musical adventure with themes of family and self-acceptance, similar to 'Moana'.

metas.name: Sing
metas.description: A koala promoter's attempt to save his theater with a singing competition brings together a diverse group of talented animals. This animated musical is full of energy and catchy songs, matching the spirit of 'Sing 2'.

metas.name: Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened and jealous when a new spaceman action figure is ordered for his young owner. This groundbreaking animated adventure set the standard for family comedy and friendship, fitting with the other 'Toy Story' films.
